blocks.text: COTABATO CITY — Police in Bongao, Tawi-Tawi, arrested three men on Saturday afternoon for allegedly stealing a pistol from a Philippine Coast Guard (PCG) member. Authorities also recovered other firearms from the suspects during the law enforcement operation in Barangay Pababag, Bongao. In a report to the Police Regional Office-Bangsamoro Autonomous Region in Muslim Mindanao (PRO-BAR) based in Parang, Maguindanao del Norte, Lt. Col. Roy Zantua, Bongao municipal police station chief, said the three men were arrested following a complaint filed by a PCG officer. READ: 2 Cagayan de Oro cops probed after guns stolen from car Col.
